name: Acorn CLI
description: The acorn CLI integration: ref-acorn-context (project_context, mode, client_routing, scope, persona patches, tool-usage rules, tooling-questions, discovery_workflow / graphcorn anchoring), the note_discovery tool, the acorn settings pane, and acorn-specific prompt sections. Uninstall to disable acorn entirely; reinstall to re-enable. Note: graphcorn session/project anchoring infrastructure (src/graph/sessions.js, src/graph/projects.js) stays in core.
